status: prospective human protocol; four-project coding-agent pilot executed; see docs/system-report.md
selector: One fixed quantized Qwen3.5-4B/SemIf configuration in both tool conditions; never a verifier or scorer.
controls: same initial states, candidate budgets and time/token budgets
blinded randomized left/right display and recorded decoding of condition order
preferenceDecision: Project-majority decisive votes, Wilson 95% lower bound > .55 to retain experimentally. With adequate data, upper bound <= .55 discards the musical prior. Otherwise inconclusive; smooth remains default.

productAcceptance.humanPreference: tools-smooth beats guidance-only under the same screening rule
productAcceptance.latency: report tool startup, renderer and selector time separately; no undeclared latency win

analysis: Project-cluster bootstrap or hierarchical preference model for final inference; supplied CLI offers a transparent project-level screening summary. Declare exclusions before unblinding.
note: Thresholds are prospective engineering/research decisions, not empirical constants. No benchmark comparing multiple models. Tools can remain useful after discarding the musical prior.
executionRecord: evidence/evaluation-v2/analysis.json; zero human ratings; thresholds unchanged

repeatedSystemOneFollowup.motivation: Reduce main-agent reasoning tokens through repeated local choices over measured tool actions, preserving final design quality.
repeatedSystemOneFollowup.input: An actual interview, approved product/visual brief, real content/assets, constraints and review policy shared by both conditions.
conditions: same main agent with design guidance
same main agent with guidance plus repeated calls to one local selector and deterministic tools
repeatedSystemOneFollowup.feedback: Clarifications and art-direction feedback are allowed, logged and supplied under a comparable policy; no zero-interview/no-direction gate.
metrics: human interactions and attempts to accepted quality
repeatedSystemOneFollowup.music: Optional secondary prior ablation; not the core architecture or acceptance gate.
repeatedSystemOneFollowup.historicalBoundary: The twelve earlier trials evaluated flat candidate generation plus end selection, not this repeated tool-guided tree. Historical results and thresholds above are unchanged.
